reader_architecture.body_dim_definition: identical direct six-slot RGB bank for V1/V2/V3: two 768D unmasked extent encodings plus four 768D extent-by-visible-mask encodings in fixed order [extent1.0_unmasked, extent1.25_unmasked, extent1.0_upper_visible, extent1.0_lower_visible, extent1.25_upper_visible, extent1.25_lower_visible]
reader_architecture.pose_dim_definition: two crop views * eight landmarks * 193 bins + sixteen original peak magnitudes
reader_architecture.quality_dim_definition: 36 fixed fields: [actor x1/W,y1/H,x2/W,y2/H,actor_area/source_area,log1p(actor_area)/log1p(source_area),extent1.0 inside-image fraction,extent1.25 inside-image fraction] followed by each 6D normalized crop transform [(actor x1-crop left)/crop W,(actor y1-crop top)/crop H,(actor x2-crop left)/crop W,(actor y2-crop top)/crop H,crop W/source W,crop H/source H] in masked slot order [extent1.0 upper_visible,extent1.0 lower_visible,extent1.25 upper_visible,extent1.25 lower_visible], then the four predictor-valid bits; identical for V1/V2/V3
reader_architecture.modality_projection: LayerNorm then Linear(input_dim,64); sum projected modalities
reader_architecture.capacity_receipt_required: exact counts of every task-trained module, including V3's conditional decoder, within matched-arm 10% range and below one million; no unused padding

training.sampler: uniform physical centers without replacement per epoch-equivalent pass
training.class_weight: inverse frequency within allowed training rows; two class weights normalized to arithmetic mean one

V3.missingness_and_normalization: BCE uses sum(class_weight*row_loss)/sum(class_weight); energy CE uses sum(class_weight*row_available*row_loss)/sum(class_weight), so unavailable rows contribute zero without denominator deletion; observed prediction loss is an unweighted mean over every training row after averaging available witnesses within each row, with unavailable rows equal zero; class weights never enter heatmap prediction

training.capacity_method: useful direct-path residual blocks, not unused padding; count V3 conditional decoder; report V0 separately
training.outer_release: all fitted arms and folds together after integrity and independent replay

candidate.common_availability: identical cache mask including observable pose availability for every arm; never human usability
candidate.primary_BA_population: all true classes0/1, including unavailable measurements; use context path for missing inputs

screen_gates.diagnostic_slice_warning: held-label gate only; never use historical error membership to select training rows or policy inputs

nested_integration.F_definition: complete historical ARFTR selection/refit recipe plus qualified reader(s), using only supplied training scenario set
nested_integration.block_algorithm: sort scenario strings by (sha256(prefix+scenario), scenario), round-robin into three blocks; recompute inside every restricted population
nested_integration.policy_training: for each I in blocks(S), predict I using F(S-I)
nested_integration.calibration_procedure: for each J in blocks(S), rebuild policy training on T=S-J, including F(T-I_T); predict J using F(T)
nested_integration.final: refit policy using valid cross-fitted S rows; predict H using F(S)
nested_integration.ancestor_exclusions: every ancestor excludes outer H and its calibration J; policy target I excluded by its generating F
nested_integration.historical_inner_split: StratifiedGroupKFold(min(3,group_count), shuffle=True, random_state=42), train must contain all three classes
nested_integration.historical_inner_exact_populations: label-dependent and deliberately not generated by this label-blind planner
nested_integration.historical_structural_min_warning: Necessary not sufficient: three-way M4 selection then P6 cross-fitting then grouped base-C selection fails for any F population with at most four groups; labels may impose additional failures.
